page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r9a.2xlarge is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 8 dedicated vCPUs based on the x86_64 architecture, utilizing AMD EPYC 9T25 processors running at a clock speed of 2.7 GHz. The instance is configured with 64.0 GB of system memory, yielding a high resource density of 8.0 GB of RAM per vCPU core.

This server does not include local storage or integrated GPUs, meaning storage requirements must be met via network-attached block storage. It provides a baseline network bandwidth of 6 Gbps and does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses. The high memory-to-vCPU ratio makes this instance profile suitable for memory-intensive workloads such as database caching, in-memory data processing, and enterprise applications that require significant memory overhead relative to compute capacity.
